purpose: Chemistry-led screening for possible serpentinization source contexts; not a deposit or reserve model.

datasets.name: GEM Global Active Faults Database
datasets.geographic_coverage: Most deforming continental regions; known gaps include the Malay Archipelago, Madagascar, Canada, and other areas
datasets.temporal_coverage: Continuously maintained repository; imported snapshot is recorded with the ingestion run
datasets.native_resolution: Fault-trace line geometry; local positional accuracy and attributes vary by source catalogue

rights.attribution: Styron and Pagani, GEM Global Active Faults Database

datasets.permitted_use: Structural-context and fault-proximity analysis with source catalogue and coverage limitations retained.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Fault proximity alone is not evidence of permeability, fluid flow, H2 generation, migration, or accumulation.
known_limitations: The database focuses on active faults of seismogenic concern and is not a complete map of all geological fractures.
Coverage and attributes are regionally heterogeneous.

datasets.name: HydroATLAS BasinATLAS and RiverATLAS
datasets.geographic_coverage: Global hydro-environmental basin, river, and lake attributes
datasets.temporal_coverage: Version 1.0 release; individual attributes have distinct source dates
datasets.native_resolution: Hydro-environmental attributes organized at 15 arc-second framework; vector product scale varies
datasets.permitted_use: Surface-water, drainage, and catchment context after selecting and documenting individual attributes.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Surface-water or catchment attributes do not prove subsurface recharge, reactive water flow, or water-rock contact.
known_limitations: Global downloads are large and must be subsetted through a reproducible acquisition process.
Hydro-environmental surface attributes are not direct groundwater measurements.

datasets.name: GLHYMPS global permeability and porosity maps
datasets.geographic_coverage: Global, with dataset-defined coverage and class limitations to be verified per release
datasets.temporal_coverage: Static hydrogeological compilation; release/version must be recorded before ingestion
datasets.native_resolution: Dataset-defined hydrogeological polygons or gridded representation; verify selected release

rights.attribution: GLHYMPS dataset citation to be captured with the selected release

datasets.permitted_use: Broad hydrogeological permeability context after release, unit, and uncertainty validation.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Mapped permeability is not site-specific fracture permeability and does not establish H2 migration or reservoir quality.
known_limitations: Release licensing, units, and uncertainty must be verified before model inclusion.
Global hydrogeology compilations generalise local heterogeneity.

datasets.name: EarthChem Data-To-Go: Geochemical Data for Ophiolites, version February 2019
datasets.geographic_coverage: Global sample locations returned by the PetDB tectonic-setting query for ophiolite
datasets.temporal_coverage: Dataset published 2019; sample ages and collection dates vary
datasets.native_resolution: Point sample locations; does not delineate geological-body extent

rights.attribution: PetDB Team, 2019, EarthChem Data-To-Go: Geochemical Data for Ophiolites, version February 2019, DOI:10.1594/IEDA/111307

datasets.permitted_use: Global, source-attributed point anchors for ophiolite and directly sampled ultramafic source-rock context.
datasets.prohibited_inference: A sample point does not delimit an ophiolite body, prove present-day water-rock reaction, or establish H2 generation or accumulation.
known_limitations: Sampling distribution reflects research coverage and is not a global inventory of all ophiolites.
Rock type at a point cannot be expanded into an areal boundary without an independent geological map.
The dataset contains ophiolite samples beyond the direct ultramafic and serpentinite rock types relevant to the initial source-rock screen.

datasets.name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance

access.method: STAC API / Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF assets

rights.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance

datasets.permitted_use: Surface context, exposed-rock and land-surface interpretation after quality masking.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Cannot establish subsurface lithology, Fe(II) availability, H2 generation, H2 occurrence, or accumulation.
known_limitations: Optical data are affected by cloud, shadow, vegetation, and surface cover.
Mapped surface expression does not prove buried geology or reactive mineralogy.

datasets.name: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
datasets.geographic_coverage: Global scene-based coverage where a valid product is generated
datasets.native_resolution: 30 m source imagery; use product metadata and QA

access.method: STAC API / Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF assets

rights.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature

datasets.permitted_use: Environmental surface-context exploration with quality controls.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Surface temperature is not a measurement of subsurface temperature, serpentinization, or H2 flux.
known_limitations: Not all scenes produce a surface-temperature product.
Atmospheric conditions and land cover affect interpretation.

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission terrain data
datasets.provider: USGS-hosted LP DAAC / NASA SRTM mission
datasets.geographic_coverage: Approximately 60 degrees north to 56 degrees south
datasets.native_resolution: Product-dependent; verify exact product before ingestion
datasets.permitted_use: Terrain, drainage, slope, and accessibility context.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Terrain lineaments are not proof of active faults, permeability, water access, or H2 generation.
known_limitations: Does not cover polar regions beyond the stated latitude range.
A DEM is not a lithology or subsurface-structure dataset.

datasets.name: USGS Data Series 414 ultramafic-rock database
datasets.temporal_coverage: Published 2009; compiled from varied-scale geologic mapping
datasets.native_resolution: Varied by contributing map; inspect feature-level metadata

rights.attribution: Krevor and others, 2009, USGS Data Series 414

datasets.permitted_use: CONUS pilot source-rock extent and methodology benchmark.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Ultramafic rock extent alone does not establish H2 generation or accumulation.
known_limitations: Original compilation purpose was mineral carbon-dioxide sequestration, not natural hydrogen.

datasets.name: Preliminary map showing global distribution of alpine-type ultramafic rocks and blueschists
datasets.native_resolution: Historic preliminary map; do not treat as current feature-resolution data

rights.attribution: Irwin and Coleman, 1972, USGS Miscellaneous Field Studies Map 340

datasets.permitted_use: Historical discovery reference and comparison layer after documented digitisation.
datasets.prohibited_inference: Not a current global production geology layer and not evidence of H2.
known_limitations: May omit or generalise features and requires provenance-preserving digitisation.
